identification: Box of reference books: (1) Garnett and Gosse, English Literature: An Illustrated Record, 4 vols, William Heinemann, London (first published 1903-04), publishers red cloth, gilt spines, vol III has a chipped head of spine, vol I title page shows Henry VIII seal; vol 4 title-page plate is a Chaucer manuscript facsimile. (2) The Oxford Library of English Usage, 3 vols in slipcase (Grammar, Spelling, Usage). (3) The Oxford Library of Words and Phrases, 3 vols in slipcase (Quotations, Proverbs, Word Origins). Oxford sets are c.1990 reprint sets, very common.

viewing_check: Estimate A$30-40, current bid A$10. For all four Garnett & Gosse volumes, read the title-page imprint first: 'London: William Heinemann' 1903 = first issue; Heinemann 1906 or mixed dates = reissue; 'New York: Grosset & Dunlap' (can be dated 1904) or Macmillan with Erskine supplement = later. Check plates and tissue guards are present, hinges sound, and the Vol III spine chip. Check the Oxford Words and Phrases copyright page for 'BCA' (book-club). Look in the box for anything not photographed. Fair buy up to about A$45 hammer (A$55 with 22% premium); nothing here is a hidden rarity.
